outputs.explanation: The spatial expression panels are heatmap-style visualizations overlaid on tissue images, not averaged summary plots requiring individual data points.
Panel B consists of micrograph/RNAscope images, not a plot.
The scatter plot shows every individual patient tumor data point (LUAD and LUSC) with median and 95% CI overlaid.
The bar chart (mean ± SD) has individual replicate data points (n=3) overlaid as dots for each group.
